immucan._comment_name_mappings: Re-checked against model_assets/marker_metadata.csv (177 entries) and cross-validated against the UniProt IDs already used for these markers in VirTues/run_virtues.py's IMMUCAN_UNIPROT. SMA=ACTA2 -> A-SMA, Ecad=CDH1 -> E-CADHERIN (exact match, not a panCK proxy), TCF7 -> TCF1 (same gene/protein), CarbonicAnhydrase=CA9 -> CA9, CD303=CLEC4C -> BDCA-2. Only PDGFRb and CD33 have no KRONOS equivalent at all.

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_folds_dir: fold_indices.json's own 'train'/'test' integer lists are NOT consistent row positions into the master quantification CSV -- they come from create_validation_set_from_fold()'s per-fold-file reset index. The per-fold fold_{i}_train.csv/fold_{i}_test.csv files are read directly instead, keyed by sample_id+cell_id. Same approach as eva.json/virtues.json/kronos2.json and the classic_ml baseline.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_patch_size: Same 64px as IMMUcan -- measured directly from segmentationMap.tif (image 1, 38,112 cells): mean bbox 10.7x10.3px, p95 16x15px, max 36x30px, essentially the same cell footprint as IMMUcan's ~9.5x10.6px.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_name_mappings: Re-checked directly against model_assets/marker_metadata.csv (177 entries): CD57 and CD15 are already exact bare matches (the draft of this config had wrongly listed CD57 as having no equivalent). TCRgd -> TCR_GD and Na-K ATPase -> NAKATP are real exact matches once mapped (also not in the draft). The draft's IL-10 -> IL10 mapping does NOT resolve (no IL10/IL-10/interleukin-10 entry exists under any spelling) -- moved to no_equivalent instead of silently normalising against the wrong stats.
